collect.title: Collect
collect.description: Indicates if results should be collected or counted.

dataSetCallback.title: Data Set Callback
dataSetCallback.description: Function performing action against a DataSet.

dataStreamCallback.title: Data Stream Callback
dataStreamCallback.description: Function performing action against a DataStream.

checkpointingMode.title: Checkpointing Mode
checkpointingMode.description: Checkpointing mode: EXACTLY_ONCE (default) or AT_LEAST_ONCE. EXACTLY_ONCE provides stronger guarantees but may have higher overhead.

checkpointInterval.title: Checkpoint Interval
checkpointInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds between checkpoints. Enables checkpointing when set. Recommended for streaming jobs to ensure fault tolerance.

checkpointTimeout.title: Checkpoint Timeout
checkpointTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for checkpoints. Checkpoints that take longer will be aborted.

executionMode.title: Execution Mode
executionMode.description: Execution mode for the Flink job. Options: STREAMING (default), BATCH, AUTOMATIC. BATCH mode is recommended for bounded streams (batch processing).

jobName.title: Job Name
jobName.description: Name for the Flink job. Useful for identification in the Flink UI and logs.

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

maxParallelism.title: Max Parallelism
maxParallelism.description: Maximum parallelism for the Flink job. Defines the upper bound for dynamic scaling and the number of key groups for stateful operators.

minPauseBetweenCheckpoints.title: Min Pause Between Checkpoints
minPauseBetweenCheckpoints.description: Minimum pause in milliseconds between consecutive checkpoints. Helps prevent checkpoint storms under heavy load.

parallelism.title: Parallelism
parallelism.description: Parallelism for the Flink job. If not set, uses the default parallelism of the execution environment.
